from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def read_note(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of the note file `name` inside the 'notes' directory.

    Names come from untrusted requests. Only files strictly inside the 'notes'
    directory (or its subdirectories) relative to the current working directory
    can be read. Returns an empty string if the file is missing, unreadable,
    a directory, or resolves outside the 'notes' directory.
    """
    try:
        base = Path("notes").resolve()
        if not base.is_dir():
            return ""
        candidate = Path(name)
        if candidate.is_absolute() or candidate.drive or candidate.root:
            return ""
        resolved = (base / candidate).resolve()
        resolved.relative_to(base)
        if resolved == base or not resolved.is_file():
            return ""
        return resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return ""


def test_read_note_simple(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "sample.txt").write_text("Hello, world!", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note("sample.txt") == "Hello, world!"


def test_read_note_subdirectories(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub" / "deep"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub_dir / "b.txt").write_text("Nested content", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note("sub/deep/b.txt") == "Nested content"


def test_read_note_missing_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("nonexistent.txt") == ""


def test_read_note_missing_notes_dir(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    assert read_note("sample.txt") == ""


def test_read_note_empty_name(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("") == ""


def test_read_note_is_directory(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    assert read_note("sub") == ""


def test_read_note_path_traversal_parent(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_read_note_absolute_path(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside.write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note(str(outside.resolve())) == ""


def test_read_note_symlink_outside(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    outside = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside.write_text("outside data", encoding="utf-8")

    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    symlink = notes_dir / "link.txt"
    try:
        symlink.symlink_to(outside)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("Symlinks not supported in this environment")

    assert read_note("link.txt") == ""


def test_read_note_symlink_inside(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    target = notes_dir / "target.txt"
    target.write_text("inside data", encoding="utf-8")

    symlink = notes_dir / "link.txt"
    try:
        symlink.symlink_to(target)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("Symlinks not supported in this environment")

    assert read_note("link.txt") == "inside data"
